source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.8.0, data build 981, released 2026-10-14

data.summary: 25 points. Bearer must be a DEATH GUARD model. While you control an objective marker and the unit containing the bearer is inside that marker's range, attacks by models in that unit may re-roll their Wound rolls.

effects.appliesTo: attacks by models in the bearer's unit
effects.condition: bearer's unit within range of an objective marker you control
